description: Create or remove public link — Creates a share URL for an object or removes an existing link when `unlink=true`.

_async.description: Run the command asynchronously. Returns a job id immediately.

_group.description: Assign the request to a custom stats group.

expire.description: Optional expiration time for the public link, formatted as supported by the backend.

fs.description: Remote name or path hosting the object for which to manage a public link.

remote.description: Path within `fs` to the object for which to create or remove a public link.

unlink.description: Set to true to remove an existing public link instead of creating one.

name: operations_publiclink
